author: HBO Max
description:
On DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast Season 2, Episode 1, hosts Frankey Smith and Coy Jandreau sit down with Milly Alcock (Kara Zor-El) for a conversation about Supergirl and the emotional core of Kara Zor-El in the new DCU film. From exclusive behind-the-scenes stories about filming brutal stunt sequences and speaking Kryptonese to Milly calling Kara “a hot mess in a cape,” this episode connects fans with her Supergirl.

Frankey and Coy kick off Season 2 with one of the most honest superhero interviews yet, diving into trauma, identity, found family, the Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow comic series, Heath Ledger’s influence, and how Milly Alcock approaches playing one of DC’s most beloved heroes. If you’re hyped for the future of the DC Universe, this episode is packed with behind-the-scenes details, fan energy, and the kind of comic book conversation only DC Studios Showcase can deliver.
Supergirl hits theaters June 26.

✅ Milly Alcock explains why Kara’s symbol represents pain
title: DC Studios Showcase Official Podcast | Season 2, Ep. 1| Supergirl’s Milly Alcock | HBO Max
